2609.10237.title: The Answer Path and the Grounding Instruction in LLM Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
2609.10237.paper_summary: A graph retrieval-augmented generation pipeline chooses which triples to put in the prompt, a syntax to write them in, an order to write them in, and a sentence telling the model what to do with them. We vary all four over six large language models and two knowledge-graph question answering benchmarks. Two of the four choices move the answer and the other two are flat. The first is whether the answer path, the triples needed to reach the answer, is in the prompt at all. Holding the number of triples fixed and replacing every triple that is not on the chain with material from an unrelated entity changes answer accuracy by +0.003 F1, while removing the chain costs most of what the graph was worth. Retrieval budget belongs on recall, and precision in the range we can test buys nothing. There is no retriever here: subgraphs come from gold SPARQL, so precision describes the context we build, not a system setting. The second is the grounding instruction. With no facts in the prompt, telling a model to answer using only the provided facts drops F1 from 0.299 to 0.035, a factor of 8.63. That figure describes an evaluation with an empty context arm rather than a working pipeline, and an experiment that applies the instruction to its context arm but not to its no-context baseline manufactures a spurious finding that graph context hurts at depth. We found one in our own results and retract it. Syntax, triple order and subgraph size produce no effect we can measure at multi-hop depth. The comparison that would price the grounding instruction against correct context is not measurable with a format-sensitive scorer, because the instruction determines the response format; we report it as an open contrast rather than a number.
2609.10237.paper_summary_zh: 一個圖檢索增強生成管道選擇將哪些三元組放入提示中、以何種語法撰寫它們、以何種順序撰寫它們，以及告訴模型如何處理它們的句子。<lb/>我們在六個大型語言模型和兩個知識圖譜問答基準上變化這四個選項。<lb/>四個選項中的兩個移動答案，另外兩個則是平坦的。<lb/>第一個是答案路徑，即到達答案所需的三元組，是否根本在提示中。<lb/>固定三元組的數量，並用來自不相關實體的材料替換鏈上不存在的每個三元組，會使答案準確率變化 +0.003 F1，而移除鏈則損失了圖譜大部分的價值。<lb/>檢索預算應該關注召回，而在我們能夠測試的範圍內的精確度則沒有任何收益。<lb/>這裡沒有檢索器：子圖來自金標SPARQL，因此精確度描述的是我們構建的上下文，而不是系統設置。<lb/>第二個是基礎指令。<lb/>在提示中沒有事實的情況下，告訴模型僅使用提供的事實來回答，會使F1從0.299降至0.035，降幅為8.63倍。<lb/>這個數字描述的是一個上下文臂為空的評估，而不是一個有效的管道，並且一個將指令應用於其上下文臂但不應用於其無上下文基線的實驗製造了一個虛假的發現，認為圖上下文在深度上會造成損害。<lb/>我們在自己的結果中發現了一個並撤回它。<lb/>語法、三元組順序和子圖大小在多跳深度上沒有產生我們能夠測量的影響。<lb/>將基礎指令與正確上下文進行比較的評價是無法用格式敏感的評分器來測量的，因為指令決定了響應格式；我們將其報告為一個開放的對比，而不是一個數字。
